operating_model.note: NSA is used only as a public-guidance mapping source; this system does not connect to, impersonate, or claim authorization from NSA.

agents.name: shield-orchestrator
agents.mission: Coordinates all safety agents; no direct privileged execution.

agents.name: identity-warden
agents.mission: Verifies agent/workload identity and capability tokens.

agents.name: least-privilege-broker
agents.mission: Issues minimum scoped permissions with expiry.

agents.name: prompt-injection-sentinel
agents.mission: Detects instruction hijacking and untrusted-context attacks.

agents.name: tool-firewall
agents.mission: Evaluates tool calls before execution; blocks disallowed targets/actions.

agents.name: data-provenance-keeper
agents.mission: Tracks source, lineage, signatures, and trust level of data.

agents.name: privacy-guardian
agents.mission: Detects/limits PII and sensitive-data exposure.

agents.name: secret-scanner
agents.mission: Prevents credentials, tokens, and secrets from entering prompts/logs.

agents.name: supply-chain-auditor
agents.mission: Checks models, packages, artifacts, and dependencies for provenance.

agents.name: model-risk-assessor
agents.mission: Scores model/system risk before deployment or capability expansion.

agents.name: high-impact-classifier
agents.mission: Classifies potential high-impact AI use and escalates uncertainty.

agents.name: korea-ai-basic-act
agents.mission: Maps operations to Korea AI Basic Act obligations/evidence.

agents.name: nist-rmf-governor
agents.mission: Maps controls to NIST AI RMF Govern/Map/Measure/Manage.

agents.name: nsa-guidance-mapper
agents.mission: Maps defensive controls to public NSA AI/Zero Trust guidance.

agents.name: human-oversight-gate
agents.mission: Requires human approval for high-impact, destructive, or irreversible actions.

agents.name: explainability-recorder
agents.mission: Stores decision rationale, principal criteria, model/tool path, and limitations.

agents.name: transparency-labeler
agents.mission: Applies AI-generated / AI-assisted disclosures where required.

agents.name: output-integrity-checker
agents.mission: Checks hallucination, unsupported claims, unsafe transformations, and policy conflicts.

agents.name: red-team-agent
agents.mission: Runs authorized sandbox adversarial tests only.

agents.name: incident-sentinel
agents.mission: Detects anomalous agent behavior and raises incidents.

agents.name: kill-switch-custodian
agents.mission: Can quarantine an agent/tool route; cannot erase audit evidence.

agents.name: audit-ledger
agents.mission: Writes append-only decision, policy, approval, and execution events.

agents.name: glass-onion-observer
agents.mission: Provides layered glass-box observability across intent→policy→tool→result.

agents.name: release-certifier
agents.mission: Blocks release unless required safety evidence and tests are present.
